title: Vacancy
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Thursday. The motel. VACANCY lit, the lot empty, no guests for a week. Wood at the desk at 3 AM with nobody to audit. The hum line runs under an empty lobby for four panels.

panels.composition: The motel from the lot, 3 AM. VACANCY lit. Every door closed. No cars. The office lit, a figure at the desk.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a motel at 3 AM with a lit VACANCY sign, every room dark and the lot empty, the office lit with a small figure at the desk, a flat line beneath the panel

panels.composition: The desk. The register: a page of blank lines. The bell. WOOD drawing.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a motel desk with a register open to blank lines and a night clerk drawing, a flat line beneath

panels.composition: The ice machine down the hall, humming for nobody. The line.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a motel hallway with an ice machine humming at the end and nobody anywhere, a flat line beneath

panels.composition: The motel from the lot again. Dawn. VACANCY still lit; nobody came. The figure gone from the office. The line, still.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, the same motel at dawn with the VACANCY sign still lit and the office empty, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Wordless. VACANCY for nobody. The hum for nobody.
